sourceInput: Owner-supplied address_sofia.csv; original left unchanged; recoverable local source copy kept outside the repository and frontend bundles.
sourcePrecision: Six decimal places; n is latitude and e is longitude. No invented extra precision.
landmarkGuard: A relative landmark such as 'срещу блок 353' is not a venue postal address and is now explicitly rejected by the offline matcher. No nearest, first, averaged or centroid result is accepted.

next35NewBusinesses.review: Each selected source street/house/suffix/entrance independently compared with its sole exact municipal row. Ordinary branch numbering and residential block numbering kept distinct.

spatialDiscrepancies.evidence: Actual current owner address hyperlink publishes this exact literal destination. A second owner marker is about17m away. The121m difference from the postal point is not proof that either represents the physical entrance. No parcel-size assumption and no map viewport used. Existing owner-intended destination retained, not replaced with a postal centre.

Current owner source confirms the exact street and service phone, but only a short map link and a name-only iframe query; no literal old destination or entrance. No map request made. Precise distance disabled; directions use the complete actual postal address. Do not substitute the municipal point without physical-site confirmation.

limits: Postal-address evidence is not proof of business operation or an exact entrance. Existing factual owner-source business reviews remain required. No calls, customer coordinates, external geocoding, real bookings, notifications or production data writes.
